limitations: 配对 bootstrap 以 case 为独立单位，先平均同一 case 的匹配重复；小样本仅作探索。
Self-authored bounded tool benchmark, not Terminal-Bench or arbitrary Bash end-to-end accuracy.
Two different model families; parameter count does not establish stronger capability or lower cost.
Local token/compute/time measures are resource proxies, not API charges or measured electricity cost.
Few independent heldout cases; descriptive intervals are exploratory.
End-to-end duration includes model loads, routing and fallback; provider load is also reported separately.
Misrouting labels use separate fixed-model observations and cannot prove a counterfactual under model variability.
No human judge, online gray release, production feedback, or learned router training is established.

selection.selection_rule: Development records only; missing/incomplete attempts remain unsuccessful in the shared case denominator. Reference maximizes overall success; each family maximizes success and prefers the economical model on ties. Remaining ties use lexical model IDs; model size never determines capability. Economical model minimizes development mean provider_compute_ms with complete case/metric coverage; this timing proxy is not an API-price estimate.
